question: Why is the knowledge of the trembling knowers described as unstable?
premises: Knowledge has arisen in these practitioners.
Their knowledge is not very clear because it is connected with other thoughts.
Their knowledge is also not uprooted in its nature.
inference: The trembling knowers have genuine but incomplete realization, still mixed with conceptual thought and not fully eradicated of latent tendencies.
plain_english: Because knowledge has arisen in them, but it is not very clear due to connection with other thoughts, nor is its nature completely uprooted.
